items.quote: an agent who personally wouldn’t spend more than $50,000 struggles to justify a multimillion-dollar deal. Because in that moment, the client is selling their belief to the agent, not the other way around.

items.quote: Most agents don’t even question what “too expensive” actually means. And that’s why they lose deals.

items.quote: What if you stopped seeing objections as something to “handle” and started seeing them as concerns the client simply needs help overcoming?
items.statement: What if you stopped seeing objections as something to 'handle' and started seeing them as concerns the client simply needs help overcoming?

items.quote: That’s exactly what I do with my private coaching clients—I help them reprogram their mindset so they no longer feel stuck when facing objections.
items.statement: That’s exactly what I do with my private coaching clients—I help them reprogram their mindset so they no longer feel stuck when facing objections.

items.quote: Most agents think objection handling is about techniques. It’s not. It’s about positioning, mindset, and the way you frame reality.
